title: Section 12 Limitation Act — Time for copies

content.overview: Exclude the starting day. For appeal, revision and review, also exclude the time requisitely spent obtaining the copy.
content.study: Requisite means the time the copying office actually needed after a proper application. Dilatory applicants do not get the calendar they wasted.
